Off Calendar Sep-20-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name for an adult and name change of a minor.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald J. Sullivan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Sonia Wong #11288.

Petitioner Ivan Gonzalez-Gallo present in pro per for self and as guardian ad litem for the minor Sofia Isabella Ljungwald. Co-Petitioner Carina Lovisa Gallo present in pro per.
Petitioners were placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication is in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to Ivan Gallo and change of name of a minor to Sofia Isabella Gallo.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
